origin: The S253 portal class-root roster. INC-197 moved it here from `git show HEAD:portal/index.html`, whose verdict depended on whether the portal change happened to be committed yet.
discipline: Fails closed in both directions: a root in the portal that is not listed is red, and a listed root that the portal no longer defines is red. Adding a class root means listing it in the same change. TCRN-CROSS-INC-399 retires tcrn-highlight because DS SettingRow and shared table rows now own the transient-target state and styling. INC-399 R2/R5 removes local shared-family metric/type/selection clones and replaces their consumers with the matching Production components. This final source roster records that removal; source conservation does not constitute visual acceptance.
notWaiver: This is a declaration of the sanctioned set, not a roster that passes a predicate known to be false. Owner ruled against the latter in MIN-099.
